source_text.body:
Negotiate an AT&T bill down
The poster used Dot to negotiate with AT&T, cutting the bill from $85 to $45 per month plus two free months in about 15-20 minutes.
Done with
DO
Dots
What they did
The poster gave Dot a separate Chrome profile and had it handle an AT&T live chat instead of doing the negotiation personally. They told it to get a discount and, if AT&T would not honor one, say they would switch to Xfinity; Dot handled the rest of the chat on its own.
How it went
The bill was reduced from $85 a month back down to $45, and AT&T also gave two free months. The thread does not include the actual chat transcript, so the exact back-and-forth and any limits of the method are not shown.
Worth knowing
It took about 15 to 20 minutes, and the poster says doing it personally the year before only got the bill down by $20 per month.
Try it yourself
with
Dots
Copy prompt
Negotiate my [AT&T] bill down. My account is [account details I'll provide securely], I pay [current amount] per month, and I'd like [target price] or credits like free months. Contact the carrier's retention team, make the case based on my loyalty and competitor offers, and finish with a summary of the new price and terms. Check with me before accepting any deal that changes my contract or adds fees.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/codex/comments/1xduiex/dot_got_my_att_bill_down_from_85_to_45_2_months
